answer_1.quote: LaMP includes four text generation datasets: (4) Personalized News Headline Generation, (5) Personalized Scholarly Title Generation, (6) Personalized Email Subject Generation, and (7) Personalized Tweet Paraphrasing.
answer_1.outputs: personalized news headlines, scholarly titles, email subjects, and paraphrased tweets

answer_2.quote: Following previous works on text generation, we use Rouge-1/Rouge-L as evaluation metrics for the text generation tasks (LaMP-4 to LaMP-7).
